title: A Friend’s Prayer
subject: English
summary: “A Friend’s Prayer” is a poem about the importance of friendship and kindness. In this poem, the poet prays to God to help us become good friends to others. It teaches us to be loving, caring, helpful and kind. We should understand our friends, share their happiness and support them during difficult times. We should also forgive others and treat everyone with respect. The poem teaches us that a true friend is always kind, helpful and caring towards others.
